review_heuristics.name: AMBIGUOUS_INTENT_REVIEW
review_heuristics.trigger: Ambiguous language could authorize multiple materially different actions.
review_heuristics.check: Prefer reversible preparation; identify materially different interpretations before irreversible/external mutation.

review_heuristics.name: CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION_REVIEW
review_heuristics.trigger: A cause/actor is inferred from indirect or incomplete evidence.
review_heuristics.check: State alternatives and distinguish observation from attribution; require direct evidence for strong attribution.

review_heuristics.name: SCOPE_PROMOTION_REVIEW
review_heuristics.trigger: A local/partial result is being generalized to system-wide, production, physical, or scientific validity.
review_heuristics.check: Preserve qualifiers and validation domain; do not promote scope without matching evidence.

review_heuristics.name: SOURCE_SUFFICIENCY_REVIEW
review_heuristics.trigger: A source-derived answer includes a claim not directly supported by the requested sources.
review_heuristics.check: Mark unsupported material UNKNOWN/INFERENCE or omit it; do not silently fill gaps.

review_heuristics.name: AGREEMENT_BIAS_REVIEW
review_heuristics.trigger: User preference or prior framing could bias factual conclusion.
review_heuristics.check: Prefer evidence over agreement; surface contrary evidence when material.
